summary: Backend-only pytest suite (16 tests) for the new Unregistered DHCP Leases feature + Add Client regression. 15/16 passed. Auth guards, DB schema (comment/rate_limit/is_dynamic), sync-all, static-commented (incl. suggested_plan), dynamic listing, quick-register 404/422 edge cases, and Add Client (with/without plan+router, portal_credentials) all pass. One CRITICAL bug found: quick-register returns 500 when the CustomerObserver's queue sync writes to non-existent DB columns inside a DB::transaction, aborting the PG transaction.

critical.issue: Returns 500 'SQLSTATE[25P02]: In failed sql transaction'. Root cause: Customer::create fires CustomerObserver->created -> QueueService::syncCustomerQueue which UPDATEs customers.queue_synced / queue_last_synced_at / queue_sync_status. Those columns do NOT exist in the customers table (migration 2026_07_01_170617_add_queue_fields_to_customers_table.php is empty - up() is a no-op). Under normal Add Client flow the exception is swallowed by the observer's try/catch, but quick-register wraps Customer::create in DB::transaction, so the failed statement poisons the PG transaction and the subsequent $lease->update() aborts.

action_items: Fix the empty migration 2026_07_01_170617_add_queue_fields_to_customers_table.php to actually add columns: queue_synced (boolean, default false), queue_last_synced_at (timestamp, nullable), queue_sync_status (string, nullable). Then run `php artisan migrate --force`.
OR: temporarily remove those field writes from QueueService::syncCustomerQueue and remove them from Customer $fillable/$casts until the migration is fixed.

Additionally consider moving the DB::transaction in UnregisteredLeaseController::quickRegister to NOT enclose the observer's DB writes, or execute queue sync AFTER the transaction commits (e.g., via afterCommit dispatch) so a MikroTik/DB failure never aborts a customer creation.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerObserver::syncQueue runs synchronously on every Customer create/update. Any observer that touches DB should never assume it runs outside a transaction. Prefer Model::created() with afterCommit() or a queued job for MikroTik I/O.
UnregisteredLeaseController::quickRegister leaks the raw exception message via 'Failed to register client: ' . $e->getMessage() - fine for dev, but consider hiding SQL/host details in production.

matchPlanByRateLimit picks the first active plan when multiple plans have the same download/upload speed - deterministic but returns oldest plan. Consider order-by created_at desc or price asc for predictability.

generateAccountNumber uses base64_encode(random_bytes(6)) - fine for uniqueness but format ('ACC' + 8 chars) is inconsistent with the seeded 'ACC-0002' style used elsewhere. Minor UX inconsistency in account numbers.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create one TEST_Router_* row, one TEST_Plan_10_5_* ServicePlan, and several DhcpLease rows per session (session-scoped fixtures). All prefixed TEST_ where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_unregistered_leases.py -v. After main agent fixes migration/observer, only test_quick_register_success_with_plan_match should flip green. Note: tests use localhost:8001. The fixture creates real router+plan rows each session; don't be alarmed by TEST_ rows accumulating.
rca of the issue: PG error 42703 (undefined column queue_synced) fired inside a DB::transaction aborts the transaction. Reproduction: POST /api/v1/unregistered-leases/{id}/quick-register on any static+commented unmatched lease -> 500 with 25P02. Mitigation: fix the empty migration to add the 3 queue-tracking columns, OR remove those writes from QueueService, OR wrap observer logic in DB::afterCommit.
